title: 实验 3-3 · RL 电路：电感电压的尖峰与电流的斜坡
summary: 方波驱动 100 Ω + 10 mH 串联电路：电感两端是一跳一衰减的尖峰，电阻电压（= 电流 × R）是慢慢爬升的斜坡。
concepts: 电感电流不能突变 continuity of inductor current
用电阻电压观察电流 current via a sense resistor
description: **目标**：用方波驱动 RL 电路，在示波器上看电感电流连续、电感电压可以跳变，并和 RC 电路对比。
**电路**：信号发生器红夹子 → R1（100 Ω）→ 结点 VL → L1（10 mH）→ GND，黑夹子接 GND。
**信号发生器**：方波，幅度 1 V、偏置 0（±1 V，每次跳 2 V），频率 1 kHz（半周期 0.5 ms）。
**示波器**：CH1 接信号发生器输出 VIN，CH2 接 VL（电感上端）。电阻电压 u_R = CH1 − CH2，许多示波器有 MATH 功能直接相减；u_R / 100 Ω 就是电流。为什么不直接把探头夹在电阻两端？真实示波器的地夹是接大地的，信号发生器的黑夹子也是，所以地夹只能夹在 GND 上，否则会把电路某一点短路到地。这就是把电感放在接地一侧、用“两个通道相减”看电阻电压的原因。
**先预测**：电感电流不能突变（i_L(0+) = i_L(0−)），u_L = L·di/dt。算出回路总电阻（要算上信号发生器 50 Ω 和电感线圈电阻 1 Ω）、τ = L/R总 和稳态电流；半周期是几个 τ？方波跳变的瞬间，2 V 的跳变落在谁身上？再想 10 kHz 时会怎样。
**测量**：1 kHz 下读电阻电压（CH1 − CH2）的范围和电感电压的尖峰；再把频率调到 10 kHz 看两者的变化。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**想一想（和 RC 对比）**：RC 中电容**电压**连续、电流可以跳；RL 中电感**电流**连续、电压可以跳。实际电路里突然切断电感电流（di/dt 极大）会产生很高的反向电压，这就是继电器线圈旁边要并一个续流二极管的原因。
**真实电路里**：仿真里线圈电阻只有 1 Ω。真实的 10 mH 小电感线圈电阻常在 10 ~ 30 Ω，它会加进 R总，使 τ 变小、稳态电流变小，电感电压衰减后也停在更高的电平上。

en.title: Experiment 3-3 · RL circuit: inductor voltage spikes and a current ramp
en.summary: A square wave drives 100 Ω + 10 mH in series: the inductor shows a jump-and-decay spike, the resistor voltage (= current × R) a slow ramp.
concepts: seeing current through a sense resistor
description: **Goal**: drive an RL circuit with a square wave and see on the scope that the inductor current is continuous while the inductor voltage can jump; compare with the RC circuit.
**Circuit**: generator red clip → R1 (100 Ω) → node VL → L1 (10 mH) → GND; black clip to GND.
**Generator**: square wave, amplitude 1 V, offset 0 (±1 V, 2 V per jump), 1 kHz (half period 0.5 ms).

**Scope**: CH1 on the generator output VIN, CH2 on VL (top of the inductor). The resistor voltage is u_R = CH1 − CH2 — many scopes have a MATH function that subtracts them; u_R / 100 Ω is the current. Why not clip a probe straight across the resistor? A real scope's ground clip is tied to mains earth, and so is the generator's black clip, so the ground clip may only go on GND — anywhere else it shorts that point to ground. That is why the inductor sits on the grounded side and the resistor voltage is seen as the difference of two channels.

**Predict first**: inductor current cannot jump (i_L(0+) = i_L(0−)), and u_L = L·di/dt. Work out the loop resistance (including the generator's 50 Ω and the coil's 1 Ω winding), τ = L/R_total and the steady current; how many τ fit in half a period? At the instant of a jump, which element takes the 2 V step? Then think about 10 kHz.

**Measure**: at 1 kHz read the range of the resistor voltage (CH1 − CH2) and the inductor-voltage spikes; then turn the frequency up to 10 kHz and watch both change. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**Think about it (compare with RC)**: in RC the capacitor *voltage* is continuous and its current may jump; in RL the inductor *current* is continuous and its voltage may jump. Suddenly interrupting an inductor's current (huge di/dt) produces a large reverse voltage — that's why relay coils get a flyback diode across them.

**In a real circuit**: the simulated coil has only 1 Ω of winding resistance. A real small 10 mH inductor often has 10–30 Ω; it adds to R_total, so τ and the steady current get smaller and the inductor voltage settles at a higher level after the spike.
compare: - Steady current I = 1 V / 151 Ω ≈ 6.6 mA. Half a period, 0.5 ms ≈ 7.5τ, is long enough for the current to travel all the way from −6.6 mA to +6.6 mA: the resistor voltage swings between ±0.66 V (Vpp ≈ 1.32 V), with an exponential ramp after each edge.

- At the instant of a jump the current hasn't changed yet, so practically the whole 2 V step lands on the inductor: u_L jumps to about ±2 V (ideally 1 + 150/151 ≈ 1.99 V), then decays with τ down to just the ±6.6 mV across the winding resistance. The simulated scope samples every 3.9 µs and reads a spike of about 1.88 V.

- **10 kHz (half period 50 µs < τ)**: the current has no time to finish, it just climbs back and forth in the middle; the resistor voltage becomes a near-triangle with Vpp ≈ 1.32 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 1.32 × tanh(0.38) ≈ 0.48 V, while the inductor voltage stays large (most of the voltage sits on the inductor because the current keeps changing).

measurements.ask: 1 kHz: Vpp of the resistor voltage u_R (CH1 − CH2)
measurements.explain: Steady current I = 1 V / 151 Ω ≈ 6.6 mA, so u_R swings ±0.66 V, ≈ 1.32 Vpp.

measurements.ask: 1 kHz: the maximum of the CH2 (inductor voltage u_L) spikes
measurements.explain: At a jump the current hasn't changed yet, so nearly the whole 2 V step lands on the inductor: ideally 1 + 150/151 ≈ 1.99 V; sampling every 3.9 µs the scope reads about 1.9 V.

measurements.ask: 1 kHz: the 10%–90% rise time t_r of u_R (that is, of the current)
From your t_r, the time constant τ = t_r / ln 9

measurements.explain: A 50 µs half period < τ, so the current only climbs back and forth in the middle: 1.32 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 1.32 × tanh(0.38) ≈ 0.48 V.

hints: The inductor goes from VL to GND, the resistor between the generator's red clip and VL.
τ = L / (R + 50 Ω + 1 Ω). Compare it with half a period.
The current is the resistor voltage divided by 100 Ω: watch CH1 − CH2.
tests: 1 kHz: u_L spikes ± at every edge; u_R reaches its steady value every half period
10 kHz (T/2 < τ): the current can't finish its ramp, u_R shrinks

tests.name: 1 kHz：u_L 在跳变处有正负尖峰；u_R 每半周期都走到稳态
10 kHz（T/2 < τ）：电流来不及走完，u_R 变小

compare: - 稳态电流 I = 1 V / 151 Ω ≈ 6.6 mA。半周期 0.5 ms ≈ 7.5τ，所以每半周期电流都能从 −6.6 mA 走到 +6.6 mA：电阻电压在 ±0.66 V 之间（Vpp ≈ 1.32 V），边沿处是指数形状的斜坡。
- 方波跳变的瞬间电流还来不及变，这 2 V 的跳变几乎全部落在电感上：u_L 跳到约 ±2 V（理想值 1 + 150/151 ≈ 1.99 V），随后以 τ 衰减到只剩线圈电阻上的 ±6.6 mV。仿真示波器每 3.9 µs 取一个点，读到的尖峰约 1.88 V。
- **10 kHz（半周期 50 µs < τ）**：电流来不及走完，只在中间来回爬，电阻电压变成近似三角波，Vpp ≈ 1.32 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 1.32 × tanh(0.38) ≈ 0.48 V；而电感电压一直很大（大部分电压都落在电感上，因为电流一直在变）。

measurements.ask: 1 kHz：电阻电压 u_R（CH1 − CH2）的 Vpp
measurements.explain: 稳态电流 I = 1 V / 151 Ω ≈ 6.6 mA，u_R 在 ±0.66 V 之间，≈ 1.32 Vpp。

measurements.ask: 1 kHz：CH2（电感电压 u_L）尖峰的最大值
measurements.explain: 跳变瞬间电流来不及变，2 V 的跳变几乎全落在电感上：理想 1 + 150/151 ≈ 1.99 V；示波器每 3.9 µs 取一点，读到约 1.9 V。

measurements.ask: 1 kHz：u_R（也就是电流）上升沿从 10% 到 90% 的时间 t_r
由你的 t_r 算时间常数 τ = t_r / ln 9

measurements.explain: 半周期 50 µs < τ，电流只在中间来回爬：1.32 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 1.32 × tanh(0.38) ≈ 0.48 V。

hints: 电感从 VL 接到 GND，电阻接在信号发生器红夹子和 VL 之间。
τ = L / (R + 50 Ω + 1 Ω)，和半个周期比一比。
电流 = 电阻电压 / 100 Ω：看 CH1 − CH2。
